The Depth Patch is an upgrade for the Practitioner's Pouch that enhances its capacity to store a larger variety of items, including those related to deep and complex magic. This patch is ideal for mages who work with intricate spells and need to carry a wide range of components.

To apply the Depth Patch, I need to combine it with a Practitioner's Pouch in a crafting table. Once applied, the patch will permanently enhance the pouch, allowing it to hold more items and providing additional slots for organization.

The Depth Patch also adds a unique visual design to the pouch, making it stand out from other pouches.
